item.title: All the U.S. Tours by Latin Artists Announced for 2026 (Updating)
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of Latin music. Today, we're talking about the thriving Latin music scene in the US, with a special focus on tours. Let's get started.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: 2025 was a big year for Latin music tours in the US. Artists like Shakira and Rauw Alejandro delivered huge numbers at the box office and created unforgettable experiences for fans. Shakira's Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour was a game-changer, grossing $327.4 million and selling 2.5 million tickets across its first 64 dates. She even received the inaugural Billboard Global Touring Icon Award for her efforts.
[Short music transition]
Host: Rauw Alejandro's Cosa Nuestra Tour was also a major success, grossing $91.7 million across its spring and summer legs. But it wasn't all smooth sailing for Latin artists in 2025. Some regional Mexican artists, like Julión Álvarez and Grupo Firme, faced challenges due to immigration policies, leading to canceled tour dates and festivals.
[Soft music continues]
Host: Looking ahead to 2026, the touring landscape is shaping up to be just as exciting. Artists like Karol G, Shakira, and Don Omar have already announced their outings. We'll be keeping an eye on these tours and bringing you updates throughout the year.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll be back with more updates on the Latin music scene. For now, you can check out our list of confirmed Latin tours for 2026. Until next time, adiós.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
